caption: The drawing contains six rectangular sections, arranged in two columns and three rows on a beige background. The top left rectangle features a white background with a border of red and pink intertwined leafy vines at the top and bottom edges. The top right rectangle has a blue background decorated with outlines of yellow and white polka-dotted flowers scattered across the surface. The middle left rectangle displays a black background adorned with red and pink stylized flowers and leaves. The middle right rectangle is mostly white with a horizontal black and white braided border near the top and another at the bottom. The bottom left rectangle includes a design of green stems and red-and-pink flowers above a black and white stylized heart-patterned border running horizontally. The bottom right rectangle has a pattern of horizontal pink lines overlaid with a network of red branching lines and scattered red and white dots. Each rectangle contains a distinct, repeating decorative pattern using a limited color palette.
title: Materials from Quilt
